dct_description_sm: Research and monitoring are mainly focusing on biodiversity, conservation and population ecology. Vindelfjllen Nature Reserve is one of the largest protected areas in Europe, covering 550 000 ha. The LUVRE-project (Lund University Vindel River Expedition) has studied the breeding bird and insect fauna in the Ammarns area, Vindelfjllen Nature Reserve, annually since 1963.
dct_title_s: post-LUVRE: insects and bird studies in Vindelfjllen Nature Reserve, Sweden
